steps.name: deploy to VM
steps.run:
echo "${{ secrets.SSH_PRIVATE_KEY }}" > ~/ssh_key
chmod 600 ~/ssh_key

ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -i ~/ssh_key root@64.227.169.180 -t "
  docker stop user-app-backend || true &&
  docker rm user-app-backend || true &&
  docker pull 100xdevs/user-app-backend:${{ github.sha }} &&
  docker run -d \
    --name user-app-backend \
    -p 8080:8080 \
    100xdevs/user-app-backend:${{ github.sha }}
"
